description: Real NodeGoat findings from the ASVA pipeline, hardcoded for the RAG demo and evaluation. Built by tools/build_fixture.py from ASVA's triage batches (normalised + triaged Snyk findings) plus each rule's CWE ids from the Snyk SARIF files ('sarif_cwes'). Nothing reads the asva folder at runtime.
